_metadata.description: Scanner that reads existing scenario state and auto-populates draft brands, extensible to additional frameworks via scanner plugins.

requirements.title: Scan scenario state into a draft brand with confidence scores
requirements.description: The scanner inspects service.json, theme/token files, static assets, manifests, and DESIGN.md to assemble a draft brand, attaching a per-field confidence score reflecting evidence strength.

validation.notes: Planned unit coverage at api/internal/discovery/scanner_test.go once the discovery scanner is ported.

requirements.title: Extract a color system from CSS and JSON token sources
requirements.description: The default scanners parse CSS custom properties and JSON token files to recover a candidate color system and typography for the draft brand.

validation.notes: Planned unit coverage at api/internal/discovery/css_scanner_test.go once the default scanners are ported.

requirements.title: Support per-framework scanner plugins beyond CSS and JSON
requirements.description: Scanning is plugin-based so additional framework/language scanners (e.g. Tailwind config, SCSS) can be registered without modifying the core scan loop.

validation.notes: Planned unit coverage at api/internal/discovery/plugins_test.go once the scanner-plugin registry is ported.
